race.comment: Wide open. LADY ELSA (4) is fitter for three runs back and put the writing on the wall last time when a close-up fourth in a richer maiden last time at Pakenham on the synthetic. Extra trip looks a plus and should be at top. Go close on recent ratings. SIR ROCKFORD (1) is mixing form and was beaten a fair way on the very heavy at Warrnambool last time. Went close in a far richer race two back. Has placed 2/3 here and aided by the claim. Gets chance to atone. MIDNIGHT GLOW (2) is fitter for three runs in and looks ready to fire over the extra ground. CHATEAU DANCER (8) scored a big maiden win last time at Bairnsdale and help fresh since. Can go on with it. PROVEN RECORD (13) is ready to win and is among the main chances. Hopes don't end there.
